Home Secretary Apologizes to Supreme Court Over Delhi Internet Shutdown

India's Home Secretary has offered an unconditional apology to the Supreme Court regarding the internet shutdown in Delhi. The Home Secretary stated that the order was not intentionally violated and that the step was necessary for maintaining law and order. The apology comes after the Supreme Court questioned the authorities on the internet ban.
